snippet.title: Future Knight - Official Launch Trailer | OUT NOW
snippet.description:
The wait is finally over! Studio Koba and Aeternum Game Studios are incredibly proud to present the official launch trailer for Future Knight. Born from a shared passion for neo-retro aesthetics and intense action, this collaboration brings you a unique experience where stunning LCD-style art meets an unforgettable soundtrack.

Experience razor-sharp gameplay where every input feels incredibly precise and responsive, making you and the character feel like a single entity. Take control of our unconventional duo—Future Knight and his bizarre companion, "Two More" (a sentient, benign tumor)—as they blast through hordes of enemies. Enjoy absolute freedom of action and a brilliant dose of dark humor in an action-packed adventure that refuses to take itself too seriously. 

Future Knight is AVAILABLE NOW on PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, Xbox, and PC! 

🎮 Get your copy today:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4235410/Future_Knight  
PlayStation Store: https://store.playstation.com/en-dk/concept/10018873
Nintendo eShop: https://www.nintendo.com/es-es/Juegos/Programas-descargables-Nintendo-Switch/Future-Knight-3151132.html
Xbox Store
